name: Blogs & Brands
heading: Blog and Brand Name Generators
seoTitle: Blog and Brand Name Generators | The Name Generators
description: Names for blogs and brands, and how to check they're free to use.
seoDescription: Blog name ideas for 20 topics and brandable one-word brand names in 18 styles, with tips on checking a name is free before you launch.
intro:
A blog or brand name has to work as a web address, a social handle and a logo, so short and distinctive beats clever. The Blog Name Generator works by topic, from fitness to finance; the Brand Name Generator gives you single brandable words in 18 styles, from tech to heritage.

Whichever you use, check the domain and handles before you fall for a name. The Business Name Generator explains how to check company registers and trade marks too.

featured.note: names for 20 blog topics, from beauty and fitness to finance and gaming.
single brandable words in 18 styles, like tech, luxury and nature, or a mix of them all.

name: Events
heading: Event Name Generators
seoTitle: Event Name Ideas: Parties, Festivals, Quiz Nights and More
description: Names for parties, festivals, gigs, fundraisers, quiz nights, and hen and stag dos.
seoDescription: Event name ideas for parties, festivals, gigs, fundraisers, tournaments, quiz nights, hen and stag dos and work events, with tips for choosing one.
intro: Naming a party, festival, quiz night or fundraiser? The Event Name Generator covers nine kinds of event, from Foxglove Fayre to Tuned Up Tuesdays and Smarty Pints. Its guide covers what makes an event name work and the checks to make before you print the posters.

featured.note: nine kinds of event, from festivals and gigs to quiz nights and hen dos.

name: Fantasy
heading: Fantasy Name Generators for D&D, Stories and Games
seoTitle: Fantasy Name Generators for D&D, Stories and Games
description: Elves, dwarves, orcs, dragons, wizards, demons and more, for D&D, stories and games.
seoDescription: Fantasy name generators for D&D, novels and games: elves, dwarves, orcs, dragons, wizards, demons, angels and fairies, plus epithets and titles.
intro:
Fantasy names work best when they follow the rules of their world. An elf from Tolkien sounds different from a D&D elf, and a Skyrim orc is named nothing like a Warcraft one. These generators follow those traditions, and each page explains how names in that world work, so you can bend the rules on purpose.

Most characters need more than a name. Add an epithet (the Bold, Dragonslayer) with the Epithet Generator, a hometown from the place name generators and a weapon from the weapon and item generators.

featured.note: real Tolkien elves with their meanings, D&D-style names and original ones.
full names with gro- and gra-, built the way Skyrim builds them.
titles like Duke of Ashes, inspired by real demonology.
first and last names for any D&D character.

name: D&D
heading: D&D Name Generators: Races, Taverns, Towns and Magic Items
seoTitle: D&D Name Generators: Races, Taverns, Towns, Items
description: Names for D&D characters of every race, plus taverns, towns, guilds and magic items for your campaign.
seoDescription: D&D name generators for every race (tiefling, elf, dwarf, half-orc and more), plus taverns, towns, guilds, epithets and magic weapons, with each race's naming rules explained.
intro:
Every D&D race has its own naming customs. Tieflings take infernal or virtue names, dwarves carry a clan name, and elves use a child name until they come of age. These generators follow the rules from the Player's Handbook and the wider lore, and each page explains them, so a name fits your character's background instead of just sounding fantasy.

A campaign needs more than characters. Name the tavern where the party meets with the Tavern Name Generator, their hometown with the place name generators, and the loot with the weapon and item generators.

featured.note: infernal names and virtue names, as the Player's Handbook describes them.
inn and tavern names, from The Red Lion to The Drunken Owlbear.
D&D-style elf names, plus real Tolkien elves with their meanings.
add a title to any character: the Bold, Dragonslayer, of the North.

name: Folklore
heading: Fairy and Folklore Name Generators
seoTitle: Fairy and Folklore Name Generators | The Name Generators
description: Fairy names and fairy-town names inspired by folklore.
seoDescription: Fairy name generators with first names, surnames and epithets, plus names for fairy towns and hidden villages, inspired by folklore.
intro:
In folklore, people spoke about fairies carefully: they called them "the Good Folk" or "the Fair Folk" rather than risk offending them. That mix of beauty and danger is what makes fairy names fun to write.

The Fairy Name Generator builds first names, full names and grand epithets, and the Fairy Town Name Generator names the hidden places they live.

featured.note: first names, surnames and epithets, by gender.
names for hidden villages and fairy realms.

name: Music
heading: Music Name Generators
seoTitle: Music Name Generators: Projects, Albums and Gigs
description: Names for music projects, albums and gigs, from a site that began with music.
seoDescription: Music name generators for dungeon synth projects and albums, and names for gigs, club nights and open mics, from a site built by a musician.
intro:
This site started because its maker, a musician, kept needing names: for projects, albums, songs and nights out. The music generators are where that began.

The Dungeon Synth Name Generator names atmospheric fantasy projects and albums, and the Event Name Generator has a whole section for gigs, club nights and open mics.

featured.note: project and album names, from dark castles to cosy folk.
gig, club night and open mic names (choose "Gig, club night or open mic").

name: Objects
heading: Weapon and Magic Item Name Generators
seoTitle: Sword, Weapon and Magic Item Name Generators
description: Swords, axes, shields, wands, war hammers and poisons for games and stories.
seoDescription: Name generators for swords, axes, shields, wands, war hammers and poisons, plus elven, Japanese, Game of Thrones and Minecraft sword names.
intro:
Named weapons are an old tradition: Excalibur, Durendal, Kusanagi. A name turns a sword into a story, which is why a magic item that's only a "+1 longsword" is so easy to forget.

These generators cover everything from swords and axes to wands and war hammers, with separate generators for elven, Japanese, Game of Thrones and Minecraft swords. When you name an item, decide who named it and why: the best item names come with a history.

featured.note: three templates, from simple blades to full titles.
names with their English meanings.
names in the style of Ice, Needle and Oathkeeper.

name: Organisations
heading: Business, Guild and Clan Name Generators
seoTitle: Business, Company, Guild and Clan Name Generators
description: Names for businesses, companies and brands, and for guilds and clans in fantasy worlds.
seoDescription: Business, company and brand name generators with tips on checking a name is free, plus guild and clan names for fantasy worlds and games.
intro:
This category covers two kinds of group: real ones and imagined ones. For a real business, start with the Business Name Generator, whose guide explains how to turn a word into a name and check it's free to use. The Company and Brand generators give you invented and brandable names.

For fantasy worlds, the Guild and Clan generators build names for a faction, a noble house or your gaming guild.

featured.note: one-word starting points in 10 themes, and how to check a name is free.
guild names from prefixes and organisation titles, or single words.
clan and house names in 12 themes.

name: Characters
heading: Character Name Generators
seoTitle: Character Name Generators: Epithets, Assassins and Vampires
description: Epithets, assassin names and vampire names for characters in stories and games.
seoDescription: Character name generators: add an epithet like the Bold or Bloodaxe to any name, or create assassin and vampire names for stories and games.
intro:
Sometimes the name is the easy part and it's the reputation that's missing. The Epithet Generator adds one to any character (the Bold, Dragonslayer, of the North), including real epithets from history like the Unready and Bloodaxe.

For particular kinds of character, the Assassin Name Generator gives you compound names and single-word aliases, and the Vampire Name Generator gives you full names.

featured.note: type a name and add an epithet, from the Bold to Bluetooth.
compound names and single-word aliases.

name: Places
heading: Fantasy Place Name Generators: Towns, Cities and Countries
seoTitle: Fantasy Place Name Generators: Towns, Cities, Countries
description: Towns, cities and countries for fantasy worlds and maps, plus café names.
seoDescription: Name generators for fantasy towns, cities and countries, sorted by style and purpose, plus café names, with tips on how real place names are built.
intro:
Real place names are built from parts that once meant something: -ford was a river crossing, -wick a settlement, -dale a valley. Fantasy names feel real when they follow the same logic, so a mining town sounds like a mining town.

Start with the Fantasy Town Name Generator, which sorts names by what the town does, then zoom out with cities and countries. Naming a real place? The Café Name Generator is here too.

featured.note: towns sorted by what they do: mining, coastal, scholarly and more.
countries in the style of Tolkien, Game of Thrones, the Witcher and others.
city names for maps, campaigns and novels.

name: Pop Culture
heading: Name Generators for Games, Books and Films
seoTitle: Name Generators for Harry Potter, Skyrim, Warcraft and More
description: Names for Hogwarts Legacy, Harry Potter, Skyrim, Warcraft, Warhammer, Lord of the Rings and more.
seoDescription: Name generators that follow the rules of their worlds: Hogwarts Legacy, Harry Potter, Skyrim, World of Warcraft, Warhammer, Lord of the Rings and more.
intro:
Every big fantasy world has its own naming rules. Skyrim's orcs take gro- or gra- and a parent's name; the 1890s students of Hogwarts Legacy have Victorian first names; Tolkien's orcs sound nothing like Warcraft's. These generators follow those rules, and each page explains them with characters from the source.

Most of the names are new ones in each world's style, so your character fits in without borrowing someone else's.

featured.note: Victorian first names with surnames to suit your house.
full names with gro- and gra-, the way the game does it.
names in the style of Ice, Needle and Oathkeeper.
